fusions.name: Cold-Drawn Strand
fusions.desc: Snaps a cold, hard strand at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, which deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, ignores its armour and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hardened Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays stiffening strands in a cone out to 4 tiles, which deals 11 damage to everything caught in it, stuns each for 1 second and has a 50% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wire Cocoon
fusions.desc: Raises a cocoon that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Layered Wrapping
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
